sections.title: WHAT IS SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION (HAIR TATTOO)?
bullets: Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP) or hair tattoo is a pigmentation treatment that uses pigment to create the visual effect of dense, closely shaved hair. Unlike hair transplants, it does not involve surgery, leaves no scars, and provides fast results.

Scalp tattooing is a solution for baldness designed for men with significant hair loss or thinning hair who are looking for an effective, non-surgical method to combat hair loss. Micropigmentation is safe and effective.

The hair tattoo treatment is especially effective for men who keep their hair short (1–2 mm), as the pigment blends perfectly with the natural hair appearance, creating a natural, seamless look even up close.

Compared to hair transplantation, which usually adds 3,000–5,000 hairs, scalp micropigmentation (SMP) can cover the entire scalp surface with up to 60,000 pigment dots – creating a more even and visually denser result.
Scalp tattooing also allows the design of a natural hairline – individually adapted to face shape, age, and aesthetics, with no compromise on a natural look.
Hair tattoo as a solution for baldness is ideal for men who want a discreet yet effective answer to hair loss without long recovery times. Pigmentation provides a natural appearance.
Scalp micropigmentation in Slovenia also allows for designing a natural hairline – individually tailored to facial shape, age, and aesthetic preferences.
